note: Catalogue only. Locations reflect the RC1-21 category layout; imports were updated during the move. Relocate via this catalogue when needed.

dispositions.retained: Still executed by the test suite; keep in place and keep tested.
dispositions.superseded-by benchmarks/: Still functional and tested, but the unified CLI under benchmarks/ is the preferred entrypoint for new evidence generation.

benchmarks.rationale: Imported by context-benchmark-ground-truth.test.mjs and asserts the C06 metric gates (CRR/SPR/COR/CWR/PFR/RPC) from context-optimization-metrics.js. Deleting it would drop coverage of the context selector's falsifiable gates.
Exercised by context-benchmark-router.test.mjs. Covers router-side selection behaviour that the unified validation suite does not replicate. Retained for coverage.
Self-contained node --test file covering the CWR (context window retention) metric. Relocated to tests/unit by RC1-21; discovery is recursive so coverage is preserved.

Deterministic trace-replay suite. Now invoked through the unified CLI (--suite=deterministic) which wraps it in the uniform envelope (manifest/raw/metrics/report). The module is still the library entrypoint used by benchmarks/cli.mjs and must keep its exports.
Deterministic validation suite. Now invoked through the unified CLI (--suite=validation). runValidationSuite() remains the library entrypoint consumed by benchmarks/cli.mjs.
Real/dry-run suite. The unified CLI (--suite=real) calls runDryRun() only, guaranteeing no network access by default. runRealSuite() remains available for credentialed runs outside the CLI.
